speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; have you noticed this turning yellow since birth or did it appear a few days ago?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (Breastfeeding Jaundice). Based on the history of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with increasing jaundice, the clinical picture strongly suggests inadequate intake leading to dehydration and reduced stooling, rather than breast milk jaundice which typically presents later and in the absence of other symptoms. I recommend checking a Total Serum Bilirubin level to confirm the severity and rule out hemolysis. REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin
